units.source_text: 我们倚在第二层潮音洞的栏杆上。

en.t: We leaned on the railing of the second-floor Choondo.

units.source_text: 坡度缓缓的挑橹下的深深的廊沿，是由其下方的八根典雅的天竺式肘托木来支撑的，

en.t: The deep eaves of the corridor beneath the gently sloping projecting rafters were supported by eight elegant Indian-style bracket arms below them,

units.source_text: 它伸向投有月影的地面上。

en.t: and they stretched out over the ground where the moonlight had fallen.
